description: Header file defining the GLImageIOSurface class used for handling IOSurface-based images in GPU media processing on Mac, specifically for integration with VTVideoDecodeAccelerator.

classes.name: GLImageIOSurface
classes.description: A subclass of gl::GLImage that manages IOSurface objects for GPU image processing, including initialization with CVPixelBuffer, memory dumping, and size retrieval.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new GLImageIOSurface instance with specified size.

methods.name: InitializeWithCVPixelBuffer
methods.description: Initializes the image with a CVPixelBuffer, ensuring it is retained for the lifetime of the GLImage.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the image.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the image by wrapping an IOSurface, converting formats if necessary.
